title: trifolium vesiculosum subsp. mutabile
intro: Trifolium vesiculosum subsp. mutabile, commonly known as the variable clover, is a subspecies of Trifolium vesiculosum, a species of clover in the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium vesiculosum subsp. mutabile include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
